## The outcome you want

Describe the outcome, not the implementation. "I want to know when a proof stops
applying to the file that moved" is more useful than "add a --flag".
-->

## What you do today instead

<!-- The workaround, and what it costs you. This is the part that decides priority. -->

## Which of these is it

<!-- Tick one. The answer changes the shape of the change, not just its size. -->

- [ ] A new verifier adapter (a runtime UNI cannot prove yet)
- [ ] A change to the DSL or the decision engine
- [ ] A change to the evidence lifecycle (freshness, binding, reuse)
- [ ] A CLI or output change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Something else

## Have you read the constitution?

`constitution.md` is short, and it closes some doors on purpose: no control
plane, no orchestration, Postgres and Protobuf stay out of the core. If your

skipping the question.
-->
